probing_questions: Does this element earn its place for this reader, and if not, what would?
Does the reader grasp the section's one thing on the first pass?

problematique: Read the assembled page as the stated reader would, once, and say what fails the first pass: an element too dense or too detailed (simplify), the wrong element for its point (replace), one that repeats the text (drop), one in the wrong place (move), or one that reads (keep); and, per section, whether the reader grasps its one thing on the first pass. The verdicts are for the planner's next round; reasons name the element and what would fix it.
researcher_question: Does this page read on the first pass, and what fails?
